policy_said: Free for independent creators on YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok and other sites for user-made content.
Yes, you can monetise videos that use NCS music.
TikTok, Shorts and Reels need none [credit], because the sound names the track.
Not allowed: uploading the music on its own, releasing or selling it, or changing it beyond cutting it to fit.
proof.video_description_said: All NCS music is copyright free and safe for you to use on platforms like YouTube, TikTok and Twitch. You may not use any track for the purpose of creating a listening experience where the music is the primary focus of the video.
